plan.description: The pipeline plan file (docs/schemas/pipeline-plan.schema.json): absolute, or relative to the subplan file. `--plan` overrides it.

task.description: The plan task this subplan splits; every subtask belongs to it.
Optional; when present it must equal the subplan's `task`.

paths.description: Repo-relative, never absolute and without `..` segments (both are errors); each equal to or under one of the task's owned paths, outside its exclusions, and disjoint from every subtask it is not ordered with by deps.

deps.description: Subtask ids of this subplan; no cycle.

implementer.description: registry pipeline.agents key (claude or codex): the model of the fresh sub-session.

reviewer.description: default: pipeline.review_pairing[implementer]; never the implementer's model

placement.description: Where the subtask's sessions run: shared (default) is the task worktree (small, disjoint files, narrow tests; the sub-session does not commit), child an Orca child of it (`dispatch --subplan ... --subtask <id>` prints `worker-start --worktree new-child`; the sub-session commits on its child branch, the task lead merges it and removes the child at once). Never child in a no-worktree repo (Unity project).

reason.description: Why the placement; required (non-empty) when placement is child: parallel full suites, generated/build output, risky work, a frozen QA checkout.
